Dear Viumo Family,

We want to let you know that Viumo version 1.1.4 is currently being prepared as a focused maintenance and bug-fix update.

We've received reports from users experiencing issues when opening movie details, as well as an issue affecting the Next Episode button after resuming previously watched episodes. We're looking into these issues carefully so that the patch addresses the underlying problems rather than simply masking the symptoms.

Version 1.1.4 will therefore focus primarily on reliability, playback flow, and fixing reported issues rather than introducing major new features.

A special thank you to the Viumo user who submitted a detailed report including their device information, reproduction steps, and suggestions. Reports like this make it much easier for us to understand problems that may not appear during our own testing.

Your suggestion regarding language selection — particularly for shows available in different languages such as Hindi — has also been noted. We appreciate the idea and will evaluate it separately as a future improvement.
